deliverables: Add a fail-closed pull-request preflight for future high-assurance Factored delivery contracts.
Add a PR metadata template that pins exact candidate identity and separates evidence, audit, owner acceptance, and release intent.
Document protected-verifier and repeat-failure rules without changing current RF1H application behavior.
non_goals: No held-out or development evaluation execution.

acceptance.condition: The PR verifier fails when required metadata or the frozen contract is missing or malformed.
required_evidence: Negative verifier execution against malformed/missing metadata fixtures or equivalent deterministic audit evidence.

acceptance.condition: The verifier binds the PR to the exact current head SHA and exact current base SHA.
required_evidence: Deterministic positive and wrong-SHA negative checks.

acceptance.condition: Forbidden write surfaces fail closed and protected-verifier changes require an explicit governed disposition.
required_evidence: Deterministic path-scope and protected-surface negative checks.

acceptance.condition: A ready-for-review PR cannot pass with pending evidence, audit, or owner acceptance.
The governance bootstrap does not change Factored application, evaluation, data, or RF1H test behavior.
required_evidence: Exact changed-file list bound to the final PR head.

acceptance.condition: A fresh independent auditor reviews the governance mechanism before merge.
required_evidence: Canonical independent audit and reconciliation bound to the exact candidate.
